   Drawing on open data from the City of Toronto, from driver receipts, and from a simulation model, we can see how Uber is using its algorithmic pricing to test ridehail drivers' limits for low pay, and pushing passengers' patience for wait times.
   The one sector that benefits from their efforts is, of course, Uber itself.
